displayedInputs.question: A strip of paper is 6 centimeters long. 2 centimeters are cut off. How many centimeters remain? Calculate: \(6-2=?\)
The flagpole is about 3 meters tall, and the lectern is about 1 meter long. About how many meters taller is the flagpole than the lectern? Calculate: \(3-1=?\)
Each box contains 8 notebooks, and there are 6 boxes in total. How many notebooks are there altogether? Calculate: \(8\times6=?\)

choices.A: Dividing a total into several equal groups and finding the amount in each group
choices.B: Finding the sum of several equal addends
choices.C: Comparing 2 numbers to see which is greater

displayedInputs.question: 12 candies are shared equally among 3 students. How many candies does each student get? Calculate: \(12\div3=?\)
63 balloons are divided into 9 equal groups. How many balloons are in each group? Calculate: \(63\div9=?\)
About how long is 1 centimeter? When using your body as a ruler to estimate length, what is the shortest segment often close to?

choices.A: The width of a fingernail is about 1 centimeter
choices.C: The length of a classroom is about 1 centimeter

displayedInputs.question: A handspan is about 1 decimeter, which is 10 centimeters. About how many centimeters are 3 handspans? Calculate: \(3\times10=?\)
A desk measures about 2 handspans. Take each handspan as 10 centimeters. About how many centimeters does the desk measure? Calculate: \(2\times10=?\)
A rope is measured with a ruler to be 15 centimeters long, while its estimated length was 12 centimeters. How many centimeters greater is the measured length than the estimate? Calculate: \(15-12=?\)
20 stickers are divided into 4 equal groups. How many stickers are in each group? Calculate: \(20\div4=?\)
Someone says \(36 \div 6 = 5\). Check using multiplication: what is \(6 \times 5\)? Is it equal to 36? First calculate \(6 \times 5\). Calculate: \(6 \times 5 = ?\)
Each box contains 5 eggs, and there are 8 boxes in total. How many eggs are there altogether? Calculate: \(5 \times 8 = ?\)
How are east and west related?

choices.C: They are both to the south

displayedInputs.question: How are directions usually shown on a map?

choices.A: North at the top, south at the bottom, west on the left, and east on the right
choices.B: South at the top, north at the bottom, east on the left, and west on the right

displayedInputs.question: Walk 40 meters north from the school gate, then 10 meters south. How many meters north of the school gate are you now? Calculate: \(40 - 10 = ?\)
In division with a remainder, which is smaller: the remainder or the divisor?

choices.A: The remainder is smaller than the divisor
choices.B: The remainder is larger than the divisor
